quests.description_chs: 乘坐升降梯后，礼堂已经近在眼前…

quests.title: Down in the Dumps

quests.description_chs: 掉入了神秘的下水道，需要想办法尽快回到地面上…

quests.title: Procrustes' Iron Bed
quests.title_chs: 普洛克路斯忒斯的寝床
quests.description: The so-called wedding at the House of Hesperides turns out to be less delightful than expected. Pavlina tries to sacrifice Ikor for her wish, though she is fortunately thwarted by Aksinya in the end. Pavlina is also thrown into the Shadow Realm, where she will continue to face off with Aksinya...
quests.description_chs: 赫斯珀利德斯之馆的所谓婚礼并非想象中那般美好，帕芙琳娜要将伊科尔作为牺牲献祭以实现愿望，所幸仪式被阿克西妮娅打断，帕芙琳娜也被拽入影域之中，与阿克西妮娅周旋…

quests.title: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
quests.title_chs: 伟大的心锁于纤细之链
quests.description: Deep amidst the permafrost's howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye... Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?
quests.description_chs: 在冻土的暴风雪中间，居然看到了一个巨大的身影…它究竟是为什么被冰雪塑造的锁链捆缚在了这冰原之上呢？

quests.title: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants
quests.description: The giant once bound by chains upon the tundra has appeared by the sea... Where is he headed first?
quests.description_chs: 曾一度被锁链捆缚于冰原之上的巨人这次出现在了海边…他到底先要去往什么地方？

quests.title: House of the Soulless
quests.description: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...
quests.description_chs: 要完整回收「灰眸」的力量，得先回收分散在各处的力量碎片…

quests.title: The Soft Song She Sang
quests.description: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you'll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first...
quests.description_chs: 冰雪的巨人似乎想要用胸口的火焰点亮影域中浮现的灯塔。看来，得融化灯塔上的冰雪，他才可能做到这一点…

quests.title: Burn the Storehouses and the Stables
quests.description: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.
quests.description_chs: 走在路上，见到了至冬帮派的成员在欺负至冬的市民，虽然出手帮忙解决了纠纷，但是在这场小小的纠纷背后似乎还隐藏着更复杂的情况。

quests.title: Disputes Without Honor and Humanity
quests.description: The Izmaylovs are indeed trying to find a way to open the Shadow Realm under the leadership of its boss, the Little Sire. To gather more information, we must rescue Gureva from their base, an undercover operative who has lost contact...
quests.description_chs: 「伊兹梅洛」确实在其头目「小阁下」的带领下，企图找到能够打开影域的办法。为了知道更多的情报，我们得从据点救出失联的潜伏人员葛列娃…

quests.title: Ever Beneath the Waves
quests.description: A strange block of ice floats upon the water. A mysterious voice comes to you over a pipe system, claiming that there is a wooden cabin hanging upside down beneath the ice. Clear the brash ice nearby, and you might cause the cabin to show its true form...
quests.description_chs: 一块奇怪的冰正漂浮在水面。从管道传来的神秘声音宣称，冰下正有一座木屋倒悬。将附近的碎冰清除，或许就能让木屋的真身显现…

quests.title: The Sunken Ship Sailed Past, Ringing No Bells
quests.description: A wooden cabin has come to a stop above the water. This rather familiar house may currently play host to a certain old acquaintance. Is he in trouble again? Head over to ascertain the situation...
quests.description_chs: 一座冰上的木屋停在水面。这似曾相识的木屋里，或许正有一位老熟人驻足。他又遇到麻烦了吗？过去确认一下情况吧…

quests.title: In the Tranquility of Cycles
quests.description: The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.
quests.description_chs: 冰上的木屋似乎马上就要沉向海底。这段时间究竟发生了什么？那位不愿上岸的屋主是否还在木屋中？靠近木屋看看吧。
